zakat.claim_evidence: No explicit mention of "zakat" or "zakat donations" was found on the official website of Support Life Foundation (www.supportlives.org) or its donation pages in the provided search results. While Support Life Foundation is involved in "Free Food Distribution" via the Muslim Community Association (MCA) of San Francisco Bay Area, and MCA lists a "Zakah Request" service, this does not constitute explicit acceptance of zakat donations by Support Life Foundation itself. (Source: https://goodmeasuregiving.org/charity/47-1675693/)

strengths_deep_dive: Support Life Foundation demonstrates strong financial directness by directing a <cite id="2">96.6% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite> into direct services. The organization maintained low administrative overhead during this period. Additionally, its financial stability is bolstered by holding <cite id="1">7.1 months of working capital</cite> in operational reserves. While revenue decreased from <cite id="2">$1,228,678 in FY2023</cite> to <cite id="2">$1,078,197 in FY2024</cite>, these financial reserves provide operational continuity for ongoing local programs.
rich_narrative.summary: Support Life Foundation is a local community organization focused on social and economic justice across California counties. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="2">$1,078,197 in total revenue</cite> to deliver food distribution and community support programs. This represents a decrease from its FY2023 revenue of <cite id="2">$1,228,678</cite>, reflecting recent funding contraction. The charity holds a <cite id="1">Charity Navigator score of 63.0/100</cite>, placing it in an average performance tier overall. Its operations show a high degree of spending directness, directing a <cite id="2">96.6% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite> toward community programs. However, organizational governance remains weak due to undocumented board details and an absent formal theory of change.
